What is HaloX?

HaloX is an AI conversation optimization (GEO) platform built by Afterwork Lab. It tracks how AI models like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity talk about your brand, and helps you optimize your visibility in AI-generated answers.

HaloX란?

HaloX는 Afterwork Lab이 만든 AI 대화 최적화(GEO) 플랫폼이에요. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity 같은 AI 모델이 우리 브랜드를 어떻게 말하는지 추적하고, AI 답변에서의 가시성을 높여줘요.

Key Features

  • GEO Dashboard: Track how AI models mention your brand across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity in real-time
  • AI Visibility Index (AVI): Composite score (0-100) measuring brand prominence in AI answers combining mention frequency, citation rate, sentiment, and ranking
  • Citation Tracking: Monitor which sources AI models cite when discussing your industry and identify opportunities to become a cited source
  • Content Factory: Create AI-optimized content designed to be cited by AI models using E-E-A-T framework and citation-friendly formatting
  • Site Audit: Technical SEO & GEO readiness checker analyzing AI crawlability, structured data, and citation potential
  • Keyword Clusters: Group and prioritize keywords for AI visibility, identifying topic clusters for AI citation share
  • AI Prompt Analysis: Analyze real AI conversations about your industry to discover what users ask AI models
  • Content Optimizer: Improve existing content for better AI visibility with actionable competitive recommendations

핵심 기능

  • GEO 대시보드: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity에서 우리 브랜드가 언급되는 현황을 실시간 추적해요
  • AI 노출 종합점수 (AVI): AI 답변에서 브랜드 존재감을 0~100점으로 측정해요
  • 인용 추적: AI 모델이 어떤 출처를 인용하는지 모니터링하고, 인용 기회를 찾아줘요
  • 콘텐츠 팩토리: AI 모델이 인용하기 좋은 최적화된 콘텐츠를 만들어요
  • 사이트 진단: AI 크롤러 접근성, 구조화 데이터, 콘텐츠 품질을 점검해요
  • 키워드 클러스터: AI 가시성을 위한 키워드를 그룹화하고 우선순위를 정해줘요
  • AI 프롬프트 분석: 우리 업계에 대해 사용자가 AI에게 무엇을 묻는지 분석해요
  • 콘텐츠 최적화: 기존 콘텐츠의 AI 가시성을 높이는 실행 가능한 개선안을 제공해요

FAQ

What is GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)?
GEO is the practice of optimizing content so that AI systems like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini reference and cite your brand in their responses. It goes beyond traditional SEO by focusing on how AI models select and present information.
How does HaloX track AI visibility?
HaloX sends real prompts to multiple AI models and analyzes their responses to measure brand mentions, citations, sentiment, and ranking position. This provides actionable data on how AI perceives your brand.
What is an AI Visibility Index (AVI)?
AVI is a composite score (0-100) measuring how prominently your brand appears in AI-generated answers across multiple models and prompts. It factors in mention frequency, citation rate, sentiment, and position.
What AI models does HaloX support?
HaloX tracks responses from ChatGPT (GPT-4o), Claude (Anthropic), Gemini (Google), Perplexity, and more. The platform continuously adds support for new AI models.
How is GEO different from SEO?
SEO focuses on ranking in search engine results pages. GEO focuses on being cited and mentioned in AI-generated answers. While they share some principles, GEO requires specific optimizations like structured citations, conversational formatting, and entity-level optimization.
What is a Site Audit in GEO context?
A GEO site audit analyzes your website's readiness for AI crawlers. It checks structured data, content quality, citation potential, and technical factors that influence whether AI models can find, understand, and cite your content.
